description.narrative: The most significant, expected Project-level outcome is the offloading of US$3 billion in face value of NPLs (both SME and corporate), representing 0.7 percent of the total market for NPL portfolios in China. This will allow FIs to free up their capital and increase liquidity, reduce costs associated with the management of these assets and allow banks to focus on their core lending activities. IFC anticipates that the proposed investment will enhance market competitiveness in the distressed assets market in China by supporting the expansion of a leading private sector distressed asset investor, and the only active foreign investor in a SOE-dominated market.

The proposed project entails IFCs investment in a co-investment vehicle (DARP SPV) to be established with ShoreVest Capital Partners Ltd. (ShoreVest or the Company), an established private asset manager investing in both distressed assets and special situations in China. The DARP SPV will be managed by ShoreVest with an investment period of up to three years. The DARP SPV will focus on investment and resolution of non-performing loan (NPL) portfolios in China, with primary focus on portfolios comprising of SME loans and in frontier regions (the Project).

name.narrative: The DARP SPV is expected to be registered in Cayman. For each target investment, the DARP SPV will setup a separate acquisition structure consisting of a SPV in Cayman or BVI and a second SPV in Hong Kong SAR which will acquire and hold the NPL portfolios in China.
